description: Three alternating strict Mixed-61 2000x2700 gate runs per ref on one sandboxed Linux machine. Reported in full, including the null result.
note: The sets overlap: the slowest branch run (44475ms) is slower than every main run. A 0.67% median difference is not separable from run-to-run noise, and matches the 0.79% predicted by the in-process component measurement.
